passive.name: 幻梦安魂语
passive.descTemplate: 生命值提升{0}。施放共鸣解放时，回复{1}点协奏能量，每{2}秒可触发1次。重击造成治疗时，队伍中的角色获得【落梦归魂】状态，持续{4}秒。【落梦归魂】持续期间，若该角色获得同奏或响应同奏，该角色攻击提升{3}，持续{7}秒，【落梦归魂】持续时间结束时移除该效果。重击造成治疗时，队伍中的登场角色获得{5}声骸技能伤害加成，持续{6}秒。同名效果之间不可叠加。

passive.descEnRank1: Increases Max HP by 12%. Casting Resonance Liberation restores 8 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s. All Resonators in the team gain Soothed Soul for 30s when the wielder provides healing with Heavy Attack. When Soothed Soul is active, if a Resonator in the team gains Unison or triggers Unison Response, that Resonator gains 16% ATK increase for 30s. This effect is removed when Soothed Soul ends. When the wielder provides healing with Heavy Attack, the active Resonator also gains 24% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack.
